entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: De Hoeksteen in Barneveld, the Netherlands, is the second largest church building in the Netherlands. It is used by the congregation of the Gereformeerde Gemeenten in Nederland, a highly conservative denomination. The church services are conducted using exclusively the Statenvertaling of the Bible.
